source: FIDE's published per-player rating calculation and tournament report for a player new to the standard list

list_values_note: published_list values are single values quoted from FIDE's monthly standard lists for verification; the lists themselves are not redistributed

cases.checks: R-27 to R-30 (current initial-rating rule, Ra with two hypothetical 1800 opponents scored as draws); the 'Rp' column of FIDE's calculation page and tournament report follows the archived 2022-24 rule
cases.finding: The published first rating (1922) equals the current rule [V 1] §8.2.2-8.2.3; the 'Rp' value FIDE prints on the calculation page and the tournament report (1921) equals the archived 2022-24 rule [VT 2] (Ra + 20 for each half point over 50 %), as FIDE's online calculator does (calculator_initial_rating.json).
